title: Allgemeinverfügung erlassen – Einschränkungen im Bezirk Mitte

extraction.placeName: Gedenkort für Polen 1939 – 1945, Platz der Republik
extraction.summaryEn: Police issued a general order with security measures and road closures around the Government District and Tiergarten for a commemoration of the German invasion of Poland on 1 September 2026, from 6 to 20 hours. Parking and public assemblies are prohibited in the restricted areas during that time.
